After a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अ are substituted there is substituted य for the Dative -4th Case ending ए।

Terms: Some substitution
For the ending इ of the Locative -7th case singular there is substituted आम् after a अङ्ग (stem) called नदी -- यू स्त्र्याख्यौ नदी

etc., after the feminines in आ and after नी।

Terms: आम् augment
